description: Search the Mirabello Immigration Intelligence dataset (investment-migration programmes and country immigration profiles) by keywords in any of the 11 site languages, e.g. "Portugal golden visa", "Caribbean citizenship", "Panama retirement". Returns up to 10 results with id, title and a citable URL; pass an id to fetch for the full record. Built for ChatGPT deep research and company knowledge; for a specific question the dedicated tools answer more precisely.

query.description: Search words, e.g. a country, programme or topic.
